# 2283. Check if Number Has Equal Digit Count and Digit Value

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def digitCount(self, num):
        """
        :type num: str
        :rtype: bool
        """
        cnt = collections.Counter(num)
        for i, c in enumerate(num):
            if cnt[str(i)] != int(c):
                return False
        return True
```
